interpretation: The installed Windows compiler built the native actor with /W4 /WX. Both platforms passed 91 pure tests without skips.

One controller suite admitted three fresh cases under its original 60-second deadline: successful five-frame exchange, mismatched case-ID refusal, and withheld relay resume. Native per-case deadlines remained 10 seconds; the outer 65-second wait and separate 5-second cleanup did not renew them.

The successful case bound both native reports and required exact real wire counts: frontend read 96/write 144 bytes and relay read 144/write 96 bytes, exact frames, directional EOF, held identity/image/Job binding and native close receipts. These counts are source-defined strict qualification predicates, not separately exported byte counters.

The mismatch case retained frontend core failure 2 and relay core failure 0 with source-defined pipe-read refusal. Both native close receipts were confirmed. A zero relay core failure is not transport success.

The withheld-resume case observed both held child exits and Job empty after the owned Job watchdog stop. Neither native report was bound; native EOF and native close facts were not observed. Process/Job cleanup does not substitute for native close receipts.
The controller was elevated and both children were non-AppContainer. This is hosted token mechanics, not an ordinary-user or AppContainer result.
HTTP request, origin response and client sink were synthetic in-memory data. No socket, listener, DNS, proxy route, firewall rule, profile or ACL was exercised by the new mechanism.
The private report tree is retained by design. Cleanup fields cover owned process, Job and handle observations, not deletion of every file. No raw private reports are published.

The sidecar separately compiled the existing identity actor and passed 409 pure tests. Its token, pipe, restricted and paired runtime steps were skipped; its existing public build artifact step completed. This is not another pipe mechanics run.
next_step: Separate source review and authorization are required before any genuine AppContainer pipe wrapper or proxy-network integration. No automatic replay.
title: Hosted native anonymous-pipe bridge mechanics; no network or AppContainer acceptance
